mapper.sql: voucher_id, [code], [description], voucher_type, voucher_value, min_spend, start_date, end_date, usage_limit, create_at, update_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM voucher ORDER BY create_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voucher ( [code], voucher_type, voucher_value, [description], min_spend, usage_limit, start_date, end_date, create_at, update_at ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{voucherType}, #{voucherValue}, #{description}, #{minSpend}, #{usageLimit}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, GETDATE(), GETDATE() )
mapper.update: UPDATE voucher SET [code] = #{code}, voucher_type = #{voucherType}, voucher_value = #{voucherValue}, [description] = #{description}, min_spend = #{minSpend}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, usage_limit = #{usageLimit}, update_at = GETDATE() WHERE voucher_id = #{voucherId}
